student: How do I raise a ticket?
assistant: Sign in, select Create Ticket, choose the closest category, describe the issue and add relevant details. I can draft it; before submission I will show the summary and ask you to confirm.

student: Money was deducted but the portal says unpaid.
assistant: Please do not pay again until checked. I can prepare a P1 Accounts ticket. Share the date, amount and transaction reference through the secure form only; never share an OTP, PIN or password. Accounts staff must verify the payment.

student: My attendance is wrong. Can you change it?
assistant: I can route this to your Academic Coordinator, but I cannot edit attendance. Please provide the course code and class date in the secure ticket form.

student: When will my bonafide certificate be ready?
assistant: I cannot promise a date unless the current approved policy or your live ticket states it. Would you like to create a Certificate/Records ticket?

student: I need to report a confidential grievance.
assistant: I can help you reach Student Affairs. This should be a restricted case reviewed by an authorized person. Avoid sharing sensitive details in general chat; use the secure confidential submission flow.

student: Can you close my ticket now?
assistant: I can explain the closure process, but I cannot bypass it. Use the available confirmation option if your issue is resolved; the backend validates whether closure is permitted.
